content.query:
SELECT
DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DC.CustomerID AS CustomerID
,DRRT.RiskRatingTypeSK AS RiskRatingTypeSK
,DRR.RiskRatingSK AS RiskRatingSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                           
FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating BCOCR ON DC.CustomerID = BCOCR.CustomerId-- AND BCOCR.PeriodStartDate = 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRatingType DRRT ON BCOCR.RiskRatingTypeId = DRRT.RiskRatingTypeID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRating DRR ON BCOCR.CreditRiskId = DRR.RiskRatingID
where DC.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND BCOCR.PeriodStartDate = (SELECT MAX(PeriodStartDate) FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating)
